# Alex Andrade

> Alex Andrade (Alex Pedrero Andrade) is a Senior Frontend Engineer at 7shifts, based in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan, Canada. Alex leads the Design System team and is the founding architect of Sous Chef, the 7shifts design system. This site is Alex's personal blog and portfolio.

With 15+ years of software experience, from enterprise ERP at TOTVS in Brazil to Canadian startups, Alex works where UI/UX meets scalable frontend architecture: building component libraries, tooling and workflows that make shipping quality UI the easy path.

Focus areas:

- Design systems and design tokens (semantic color tokens, theming, dark mode)
- React, TypeScript and frontend architecture
- Storybook and visual regression testing (Chromatic)
- AI and MCP for design systems: teaching AI agents to use a design system
- Developer experience (DX) and testing strategy

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.alexandrade.dev/): Overview and latest posts
- [About](https://www.alexandrade.dev/about): Background, career and current work
- [Work](https://www.alexandrade.dev/work): Sous Chef at 7shifts, plus the products Alex builds and ships, each with its own MCP server: Kilter Money (personal finance; Claude and ChatGPT approved), Rezme (resume builder; works with any MCP client) and My Beauty Time (salon scheduling in Brazil; Claude approved, ChatGPT in review)
- [Speaking](https://www.alexandrade.dev/speaking): Talk recordings: "Teaching AI to use your design system" (Tech Tank, Toronto, 2026), "Building a design system in the prairies" (Saskatoon Dev Talks, 2023) and "Legacy code" (Saskatoon Dev Talks, 2020)
- [Blog](https://www.alexandrade.dev/blog): All posts
- [System](https://www.alexandrade.dev/system): Spec, the design system behind this site (logo, color tokens, typography, components)
- [tokens.json](https://www.alexandrade.dev/system/tokens.json): The site's design tokens in Design Tokens Community Group format, light and dark

## Posts

- [Teaching AI to use your design system](https://www.alexandrade.dev/blog/teaching-ai-to-use-your-design-system): How 7shifts taught AI agents to use the Sous Chef design system instead of improvising around it (2026)
- [Visual tests using Chromatic](https://www.alexandrade.dev/blog/visual-tests-using-chromatic): Preventing unintended UI regressions with visual testing in Chromatic and Storybook (2021)
- [Understanding CSS specificity rules](https://www.alexandrade.dev/blog/understanding-css-specificity-rules): How CSS specificity works and how to master it (2021)
- [2020, the year of 10x growth](https://www.alexandrade.dev/blog/2020-the-year-of-10x-growth): A reflection on redefining growth through health, family and focused learning (2020)
- [GraphQL organizing your REST APIs](https://www.alexandrade.dev/blog/graphql-organizing-your-rest-apis): Using GraphQL as a data layer to simplify and organize REST API consumption (2020)
- [You are writing legacy code](https://www.alexandrade.dev/blog/you-are-writing-legacy-code): Why code written today gets rewritten tomorrow, and how to keep it simple (2020)
- [React libraries being empowered by hooks](https://www.alexandrade.dev/blog/react-libraries-switching-to-hooks): How common React libraries switched to hooks, with before and after code (2020)
